provenance: Generated from committed repository results by frontend/build_evidence.py.

model_conditions.label: Brain only · Ubuntu VM · 2 CPU / 2 GB cgroup
model_conditions.summary: Twenty questions per model; CPU, memory and swap caps verified in the benchmark scope. Network was not disabled during these runs. Quality scores are pending; the selected model is provisional.

voice.label: Windows component measurements
voice.summary: Recorded Piper speech, cache reuse and a working voice resource ladder.

cache.caveat: First pass: 39 unseen questions. Time is chunk received to first PCM ready; no speaker/device delay. Windows development machine, outside the judged cgroup.

voice.chunking_caveat: Real TTS synthesis with simulated Brain word arrivals, a fixed 400 ms commit gate and no device delay. This is a component experiment, not an end-to-end conversation benchmark.
voice.tiers_caveat: Whole Python process RSS with silent NullPlayer on Windows; each phrase has eight words. Switches happen between turns.
voice.caveat: Voice component evidence comes from Windows development runs. Ubuntu capped whole-stack latency, memory and energy remain unmeasured.

capabilities.name: Intent routing
capabilities.detail: Common requests use cached intents; time and date are composed locally. Other questions need a local language model.

capabilities.name: Brain
capabilities.detail: Four local language models benchmarked under an Ubuntu 2 CPU / 2 GB cap. Qwen3 0.6B is the provisional choice.

capabilities.name: Voice
capabilities.detail: Piper synthesis, held speech, caching and resource tiers implemented. Recorded samples and Windows component results are available.

capabilities.name: Spine
capabilities.detail: Event bus, exact-token commit validation, cancellation and experiment tooling verified with placeholder runs.

capabilities.name: Ears
capabilities.detail: Speech recognition and microphone input are specified; this checkout contains no Ears engine implementation.

capabilities.name: Phone
capabilities.detail: Android profile is a target; phone integration is not demonstrated in this checkout.

capabilities.name: End-to-end benchmark
capabilities.detail: A real full voice loop, paired baseline and whole-stack energy measurements remain pending.
